content.text: Use insertOne() to add one document and insertMany() to add multiple documents at once.
find() returns a cursor. Use findOne() to get the first match.

questions.question: What does a projection do in MongoDB?
options: Selects which fields to include or exclude
questions.explanation: Projections control which fields appear in the query result.

faq.q: How do I find documents by _id?
faq.a: Use findOne({ _id: new ObjectId("507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") }) — you must wrap the string in ObjectId().
